postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y gnupg software-properties-common ca-certificates curl && curl -fsSL https://dl.k6.io/key.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg && echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg] https://dl.k6.io/deb stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/k6.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y k6
